taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-13 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-13
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 0 – 2.46 m (Layers 1–2, weathered/fractured zone)
Recommendation: Resistivity increases steadily with depth, indicating a shallow weathered horizon overlying increasingly competent, high-resistivity bedrock; drilling should target the 0–2.46 m weathered interval for potential groundwater storage, but given the very high resistivities (>1300 Ω·m) throughout, expect limited yield and consider this a low-priority borehole site pending further geophysical confirmation.
